I also did not find strong primary-source evidence of a documented, large-scale spyware campaign in 2024. The clearest pattern is instead localized connectivity restrictions, content takedowns, social-media monitoring, and harassment of critics, especially around elections and in Papua.","evidence":[{"title":"Indonesia: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Kominfo retained direct content-restriction power without appeals, and an election-period task force involving Bawaslu, KPU, Kominfo, and police cyber units was used to target “hoax” and polarizing content.
